identity.description: 10749 historical CAP case records, selected by CAP's jurisdiction label. Part of Alaska caselaw — CAP jurisdiction collection; see the collection index for complete coverage. Court names remain explicit; this is not exclusively state-court material. OCR may contain errors; inclusion does not establish current legal authority.

identity.name: Nevada caselaw — CAP jurisdiction collection — 1865–2019 (part-0001)
identity.description: 13707 historical CAP case records, selected by CAP's jurisdiction label. Part of Nevada caselaw — CAP jurisdiction collection; see the collection index for complete coverage. Preserves CAP's Nevada jurisdiction assignment: 13,688 Supreme Court records, 18 Court of Appeals records, and one historical Eureka County District Court record. Coverage reflects this pinned historical archive, not every decision issued by those courts. OCR may contain errors; inclusion does not establish current legal authority.

identity.name: U.S. Reports, volumes 347–349 — CAP pilot
identity.description: 2,142 historical case records from U.S. Reports volumes 347–349 in one searchable archive, supplied by the Caselaw Access Project. Includes case metadata, citation links across volumes, separately labeled opinions, footnotes, and original page references. This source selection is not a complete court term or current-law collection; OCR may contain errors.
